title: Contextual help chips and quickstart checklists for first-time flows
creator: Aisha Malik
description: Design and deliver a set of in-product contextual help 'chips' and a compact quickstart checklist that appear inline during first-run and major feature releases. The goal is to reduce time-to-first-success for new users integrating the Redwood API and console flows while keeping the surface non-intrusive for returning users. Deliverables: (1) Figma file with chip component variants, microcopy, and screenshot compositions for 4 product states; (2) exported PNG/JPEG assets sized for release notes, console modal, and in-app doc links; (3) annotated handoff spec for engineering including animation timing, accessibility labels, and localization notes; (4) a QA checklist and rollout gating metrics for the PM. Scope includes: onboarding for API key creation, first model request, viewing request details in Console, and enabling Dedicated/Private onboarding toggles. This is intentionally compact (chips + minimal checklist) rather than a full tour to avoid modal fatigue.
acceptance_criteria: Figma master file with organized pages: components, states, screenshots, export-ready frames
4 screenshot variants exported at 2x for release assets (console modal, docs tile, small tooltip, side panel)
Design handoff doc with animation specs, aria-label recommendations, and keyboard focus order
Implementation-ready microcopy for chip labels and doc-link CTAs reviewed by PM and Content
A/B rollout plan recommended with metrics: quickstart completion rate, time-to-first-success, and dismiss rate
tasks: Inventory first-run touchpoints (console, API keys, model catalog, request inspector)
Create 'chip' component system: default, hovered, keyboard-focused, dismissed state
Write microcopy with Content: <short explanatory line> + link to docs + optional inline action
Design quickstart checklist modal and a compact inline checklist variant
Produce 4 canonical screenshots with callouts and safe area overlays for localization
Annotate accessibility: aria-live regions, contrast ratios, motion-reduction alternatives
Prepare export batch and upload to shared Drive + attach to issue
Handoff session with ENG and PM; capture engineering questions and update spec
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha Malik: Initial sketch uploaded to Figma. Prototype shows chips anchored to top-right of request inspector. Need engineering input on anchoring in responsive layouts.

2026-03-04 - PM (E. Park): PM reviewed microcopy. Prefer CTAs that say 'Try sample request' instead of 'Learn more' for API-first flows. Also requested metrics to gate release (min 15% activation in canary).
2026-03-06 - Accessibility review (pending notes): Need explicit keyboard focus styles and a reduced-motion animation option. Also verify screen reader announcement order for checklist completion.

2026-03-08 - Design critique: Decided to avoid modal-first onboarding; will use inline chips + expandable checklist in the console right rail. Follow-up: create a compact screenshot variant for release notes.

2026-03-09 - Engineering (PR #1248): Implementation feasibility OK; noted that animation should be controlled by a feature flag for progressive rollout. ENG asked for exported tokens for spacing and durations.
2026-03-10 - Liam Chen: Updated Figma with tokenized spacing and motion durations. Uploaded export assets to Drive and linked PR draft. Preparing handoff notes for 2026-03-12 review.
